_comment: Shared product prices, recommended router setup and routing depths. Change specifications here so every page and quote stays consistent.

template.label: Installation template
template.description: A physical guide that the router's 90 mm round sub-base sits down inside.

routerRequirements.recommendation: We recommend a RIDGID or Ryobi compact router with the 90 mm round sub-base (part 519233001). The template is sized to this base.
routerRequirements.sameBaseFits: The same base fits RIDGID R2401 and Ryobi P601.
routerRequirements.basePlate: Part 519233001, round, 90 mm (3.543 in) outside diameter, 4 x M4 screws on a 55 mm square.
routerRequirements.bit: Bosch 85614M rabbeting bit, 1-3/8 in cut diameter, 1/2 in max cut depth, 1/4 in shank, 1/2 in bearing.
routerRequirements.depthGuidance: The router sits down inside the template, so don't add template thickness. Depth is measured from the bottom of the router base to the bottom of the bit.
routerRequirements.helpBeforeEmail: Using a different router, or have questions? Email
